title: Oil prices jump 5% on Middle East tensions and US hurricane threat
summary_full: Global bond market sell-off continues and stocks fall amid reports White House has asked to see options for more strikes against IranBusiness live – latest updatesOil prices have risen sharply amid fears about escalating tensions in the Middle East and a squeeze on production from the threat of a hurricane off the US coast.Brent crude, the international benchmark, rose by 5% to $105.3 a barrel on Thursday, triggering a wave of selling in the global bond and stock markets.
